svg.title: Return water temperature between midnight and 3 am, before and after lowering the flow to 60 °C
svg.desc: Two panels. Before, at 69 °C, the return stays above 55 °C whenever the burner fires, so it almost never condenses. After, at 60 °C, most of the firing time is below 55 °C and condensing, but the burner still starts every few minutes.
svg.text: night of 10–11 Nov, midnight to 3 am, 8 °C outside
night of 14–15 Nov, midnight to 3 am, 3 °C outside
